test_title: PYST 25: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 17 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The letter-cluster that does not belong to the group is **MRZ**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option (1): JKP**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/225390846a377ea48a8b1d49efe4d21a72e3a3ec44b2718f19105b8793ffc3bc.png] 

**Option (2): FGL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b929b66b384d0cfa5107ec03b3f2da0e503db4fb49750d20684b581997aad61.png] 

**Option (3): RSX**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc9f5a86ab083f14a671f6dd43124f8631e16e25ee0a43bae1d45d771c50ea9e.png] 

**Option (4): MRZ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8efce18bed4037e8c5eece7a0932db0ecf12bf4ba7902e523d4dfb400a56ffb0.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
